_doc: Row 84 — vulnerability gate policy (tools/osv-scan-84.mjs, docs/security/84-sbom-vuln-scan.md). Shipped components fail at HIGH, dev/CI-only at CRITICAL, unknown severity counts as HIGH. Every exception names one advisory id for one package, with reason (>= 20 chars), owner and an expiry at most max_exception_days ahead; expired exceptions stop suppressing. No secrets here.
